speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing your symptoms. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when your fever started? Also, have you experienced any muscle pain or rash?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The ice cream consumption is unusual for this presentation; can you confirm if you were exposed to unpasteurized dairy or raw milk products? Additionally, have you noticed any swelling of your hands, feet, or face recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, and fatigue in a third-trimester pregnant patient is highly suggestive of listeriosis, especially given the reported consumption of ice cream which may contain unpasteurized milk products.
